[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kichijoji is a great area to live in.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended furniture stores:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. IKEA Tokyo (approx. 20-30 minutes from Kichijoji Station) - popular option for affordable furniture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Nitori (multiple locations, including Kichijoji and nearby Mitaka) - wide range of affordable furniture, 5-minute walk from Kichijoji Station.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Oriental Bazaar (Kichijoji) - sells new and used furniture, located about 10 minutes from Kichijoji Station.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Sundai (Kichijoji) - thrift store chain with gently used furniture, about a 10-minute walk from the station.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Seria (Mitaka, 10-minute train ride from Kichijoji) - affordable home goods store.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Cainz Home (Mitaka, 10-minute train ride from Kichijoji) - home center with a variety of furniture and home goods.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for shopping:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Learn basic Japanese phrases or download a translation app.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Measure apartment and furniture spaces carefully.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Be prepared for crowds and lines, especially on weekends.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Some stores may not accept credit cards; have cash on hand.
